name: Breakbeat
why: A drum pattern that sounds like a funk drummer sped up: kick, snare, a late kick, snare, with quiet ghost snares and hats in between.

ingredients.name: The skeleton
ingredients.adds: Kick on 1, snare on 2, a kick just after 3, snare on 4. The late kick is what makes it a break and not a rock beat.

ingredients.name: A sampler kit
ingredients.adds: The Akai MPC60's gritty sampled drums.

ingredients.name: Hats
ingredients.adds: Eighth-note hats, louder on the beat.

ingredients.name: Ghost snares
ingredients.adds: Very quiet extra snares between the main hits.
ingredients.listenFor: The beat starts to roll and shuffle.

knobs.label: ghost level
knobs.below: You can no longer hear them.

ingredients.name: Sampler grit
ingredients.adds: Lowers the sound quality the way an old 12-bit sampler did.

pitfalls: Ghost snares as loud as the main snare turn the groove into a drum fill.
